name: cargo-athena-example-smoke-fetch
args:
set -e
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) __t=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl ;;
  aarch64|arm64) __t=aarch64-unknown-linux-musl ;;
  *) echo "athena: unsupported arch $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
mkdir -p /athena/bin
tar -xzf /athena/dist.tar.gz -C /athena/bin
chmod +x /athena/bin/app-$__t
export CARGO_ATHENA_OUTPUT=/athena/result
exec /athena/bin/app-$__t --cargo-athena-template cargo-athena-example-smoke-fetch
